item.title: Editorial: Political engagement must not end after election day
item.description: It is easy to look at the national political stage and feel completely disconnected from it. But people turning a blind eye to political issues they believe do not directly impact them only reflects their unwillingness to confront larger systemic issues that will undoubtedly impact us all. Politics, for better or for worse, impacts our everyday life, whether we choose to acknowledge that fact or not. item.title: IC students take advantage of snow day
item.description: On Jan. 24, Ithaca College students were notified via the IC Alert System that the college would be in remote operating status from noon Jan. 25 until 11 p.m. on Jan. 26. The alert also stated that classes on Jan. 26 would not be held in person, giving students a “snow day.” As students gear up for a cold week, evidence of students enjoying the outdoors has popped up all across campus. item.title: Star gymnast earns a spot in the record book on the vault
item.description: In the first meet of the 2025-26 season, senior Grace Murray engraved her name into Ithaca College gymnastics history, tying the program record vault score with a 9.800 score Jan. 10 against SUNY Brockport. Murray added her name in the record book next to Carolyn Nichols ’19, who surpassed the previous mark in 2018.
